tools.name: usermaven_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Usermaven workspaces that the API key can access. Calls GET /v1/workspaces with the X-API-KEY header. The public docs do not describe the response shape, so the raw JSON is returned.

tools.name: usermaven_lookup_events
tools.description: Find events by event type, time range and an optional custom attribute, such as an order id. Returns at most 10 events, newest first. Leave attribute_key and attribute_value both empty to skip the attribute filter. Needs the API key and the Server Token. Calls POST /v1/event-mutation/lookup. Changes

tools.name: usermaven_update_event_attributes
tools.description: Change the custom attributes of one event that Usermaven already ingested, for example to correct a final order price. merge (default) adds or updates the given keys; replace removes every other attribute. Reuse the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Needs the API key and the Server Token. Calls
